Requirements 5+ years in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, or a comparable production-focused role. Azure & AKS: Strong hands-on production experience (Docker, Helm), plus Linux, networking, DNS, TLS. Preferred Qualifications Familiarity with Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or SLO-based monitoring. Compensation and Benefits Base Salary: Competitive, based on location, experience, and qualifications.
